notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP) sufficient. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (it's a standard Shopify agents.md/UCP notice, generic 'Allow: /' for User-agent: *). Site is Shopify. Discovery method: fetched /collections.json (paginated, 401 collections total across 2 pages) as the authoritative taxonomy index, then cross-checked against the rendered mega-menu and each candidate collection's own PLP HTML (subcategory-list/subcategory-title blocks) to see which collections the site actually presents as nav categories vs orphaned/unlinked Shopify collections (used for old campaigns, wholesale 'Assortment code' B2B tags, or recipe blog tags). Checked English nav plus localized Danish (/da) and German (/de) homepages/menus for local-language holiday terms (jul, weihnachten, saesonpynt/saisondekoration) - all resolved to the SAME underlying collection IDs as their English counterparts (verified via collections/<handle>.json id match), so treated as duplicates, not separate rows, and noted here rather than duplicated in rows. Christmas (id 652998607197) is reachable as /collections/christmas (en), /da/collections/jul, /de/collections/weihnachten - same id/count (357), one row kept. Seasonal décor / Sæsonpynt / Saisondekoration (id 697459671389) is the site's generic 'seasonal' mega-menu umbrella (474 products) whose own subnav resolves to Christmas + Easter + Outdoor Living - it is NOT itself holiday-specific (generic 'seasonal' adjective, includes non-holiday Outdoor Living), so excluded as a row per rule 2; its genuine holiday children (Christmas, Easter) are captured directly. Christmas: parent PLP has its own live paginated product grid (200 shown + 'Show more' -> page=2, 357 total per collections.json), so it is NOT a pure grouping/nav-only node - kept as its own row (qty 357) plus its 7 official subcategory tiles found in the on-page subcategory-list block: Christmas News (53), Christmas Tree Decorations (site's contextual relabel of the 'Ornaments' collection, 137, confirmed via ornaments.json that the imagery is Christmas-tree ornaments), Christmas Candles (72), Christmas Table Setting (16), Christmas Textiles (14), Tree Toppers (12), Garlands (8). Sum of subcats (312) < parent (357), consistent with parent having some directly-tagged items outside any subcategory tile, not evidence of pure duplication. Halloween: flat category, 68 products, no subcategory-list block found on its own PLP (checked in full) - kept as single row. Easter: parent has its own product grid (45 products) plus one genuine subcategory tile 'Easter new arrivals' (26); the page's other tile labelled 'View all' just re-links to itself and was not counted as a distinct node. Checked but EXCLUDED as not part of live/discoverable taxonomy (present in collections.json but not linked from home nav, Christmas/Halloween/Easter/Seasonal-décor subnavs, or the DA/DE menus - i.e. orphaned legacy/campaign/internal collections, several clearly non-PLP in nature): Christmas Mix (33), Mistletoe (12), Nyt julepynt/'New Christmas decor' (28), New Christmas Candles (15), New for the Christmas Table (10), Weihnachtsauswahl/'Christmas selection' German-only orphan (172, different collection id than Weihnachten), Blooming Easter Basket (9), Set the table for Easter/eastertablesetting (17), Nordic Carnival (4, no confirmed Fastelavn tie-in and unlinked), Festive (2), Pumpkin (4), Krydret juletærte med pære (11 - a recipe/blog tag, not a product category), Assortment code 3 - Seasonal products autumn (0, internal wholesale code, not holiday-specific), Assortment code 4 - Christmas products (46, internal wholesale/B2B assortment code, not a customer-facing category), International Picnic Day (81, unlinked marketing microsite collection, not a recognized major holiday in scope). Also checked full collections.json title list (401 collections) for Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, New Year/nytår, Diwali, Holi, Eid, Hanukkah, Fastelavn, midsummer/sankthans, påske variants - none found beyond what's covered above; 'Father's Day Gift Guide' and 'Wedding Gift Guide' exist but are explicitly named as gift guides (landing/editorial pages per boundary rules) and are not seasonal/holiday categories in scope anyway. No Diwali/Indian-festival presence anywhere (expected - Danish/European Shopify catalog). Conclusion: three genuine holiday branches found - Christmas (parent + 7 subcategories), Halloween (flat), Easter (parent + 1 subcategory).
